title: MondayTrip
tagline: MondayTrip is a decentralized Web3 app that helps you and your friends find and book hostels together. With MondayTrip, you can create a multi-signature wallet with your friends to agree on a hostel, price, and date.
description:
Our team came from different parts of the world to be here today and a lot of us are in the same situation. We like to think practical and wanted to develop a product we would probably be the first users to onboard. A project that would make our lives easier!

We decided to create a holiday/trip events such that friends or team members (e.g., could be used for work events or even hackathons!) offer proposals. Once a consensus has been found & specific conditions are met, hostels owners (or other types of accommodation) can decide to book a reservation to the team/group. One might even envision a reputation like system, ensuring the hosts that their customers are respectful of the rules. We also add a gamification and badge system on your profile page!
how_its_made:
Considering we are building a multichain & functionality extensive Dapp, we have decided to focus on the following set of technologies:

- We use the nextjs web framework, react, typescript & tailwindcss for the styling.
- We added onramp support using the Unlimit Onramp API.
- Connection to a wallet goes through Wallet Connect.
- The smart contracts were written in solidity and deployed on base, scroll, linea, mantle, celo.
- The Dapp was deployed on Vercel.
- We initialized the process of pushing notifications by allowing connected wallet to subscribe to our Dapp.
- We later want to later implement Axelar to bridge funds to the supported networks.
